besluite.fout: 'trek' is an unnatural verb for a disease passing from person to person.
besluite.rede: 'versprei' is the natural verb here and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Three sentences in a row lean on 'Mense', and 'daarom' sits awkwardly mid-sentence.
besluite.rede: Fronting 'Daarom' gives a clearer link to the previous sentence; 'hulle' can only point to 'Mense', same people and same claim.

besluite.fout: 'sommer' is loose and colloquial for the idea of arising on its own.
besluite.rede: 'vanself' states the old belief (life arising by itself from dead matter) more exactly with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: Wine does not 'vrot'; the verb fits only one of its two nouns.
besluite.rede: 'bederf' fits both food and wine and matches the lesson's own word 'bederf', without moving the claim.

besluite.fout: The link is introduced as 'kieme en siektes' but named 'kieme en siekte' later in the lesson.
besluite.rede: Naming the same relation in the same form helps a Grade 6 reader see it is one link; the general sense is kept.

besluite.fout: 'het 'n nuwe manier gegee' without a recipient reads wooden.
besluite.rede: 'het 'n nuwe manier gebied' is the natural collocation and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: 'manier van werk' is a vague calque for a process like pasteurisation.
besluite.rede: 'metode' is the precise, grade-appropriate word; the protected 'is na Pasteur vernoem' stays intact and the sentence gets shorter.

besluite.fout: The glossary entry reads as a statement about milk rather than defining the process it names.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, and it also adds a word to a lesson near its ceiling.
